name: Arthur
tagline: Writes a full children's picture book from a topic and an age range
description: Give it a subject and the age group you are writing for, and it drafts a complete picture book from beginning to end. It then assembles a brief for a partner illustrator bot setting out what each page should show, and keeps the working draft saved so you can come back later and revise it.
author: GenXer
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
